component: Actual process death after durable commit before Rabbit ACK

broker.implementation: Real RabbitMQ Docker, dedicated UUID vhost, targeted quorum queue

assertions: One persistent message published exactly once
First real OS process exits73 after Executor durable SQL commit, before process returns to Transport ACK
Broker passive queue observation confirms unacknowledged message returned
Fresh second OS process gets terminal delivery without invoking operation
One task result, one task attempt and exact unchanged task row/outbox rows
No held resource slots/reservations and empty broker queue after restart
limitations: Owner-seeded asset.verify media fixture, empty output list; no actual native model/GPU/photo execution.
Covers crash after commit before ACK only; crash before commit, native upload ambiguity and scheduler lease recovery remain open.
Companion existing poison/dead-letter and duplicate-delivery test uses same real broker but is not a native module acceptance test.
Whole V27 and V20-V32 remain unaccepted.
